title: Portability: expose the daemon shadow projection adapter
description: Objective: land the missing production new-side adapter that task-22cfca91c5134b24aaf3e5734444fb93 needs to compare copied legacy state against the daemon without a test helper inventing current truth. Add the real apps/daemon -> @moe/import dependency edge, capture one durable store horizon, derive the versioned read-only CLAIM/LINK/BLOCKER ShadowProjection only from shipped daemon readers/events, and fail closed wherever a semantic current fact is absent or unverifiable. This is a pure read adapter; it must never mutate or activate anything.
definitionOfDone: apps/daemon/package.json declares @moe/import in dependencies, pnpm-lock.yaml carries the apps/daemon importer link, and a compiled probe inside apps/daemon imports the public bare @moe/import root and typechecks before the probe is deleted.

A focused production adapter captures one SqliteEventStore horizon and returns a deeply frozen moe-shadow-projection/1 value whose CLAIM, LINK, and BLOCKER entities are derived only from real daemon durable readers/events; unavailable semantics refuse with an exact stable code and layer rather than being fabricated from BoardProjection counts or caller bytes.

The adapter canonicalizes entity ids, fields, and ordering so unchanged durable bytes serialize identically; malformed, ambiguous, horizon-drifted, unsupported, and unreadable evidence each fail closed with their exact code/layer and no partial projection.

The production consumer invokes public compareShadowProjections with the adapter result; neither the test nor @moe/import reimplements the daemon mapping, and all comparison results remain advisory-only with no command affordance.

Real SqliteEventStore tests assert one accepted nonempty CLAIM control, explicit behavior for unavailable LINK/BLOCKER facts, a positive hostile/refusal case count, exact reason code/layer, and unchanged raw event/decision counts plus database bytes/mtime across every read.
taskRails: Do not add a dependency from @moe/import toward apps/daemon or @moe/store; dependency direction is apps/daemon -> @moe/import through public roots only.
Do not manufacture LINK/BLOCKER agreement from aggregate/byType counts, test fixtures, or unknown event payloads; missing semantic authority remains UNKNOWN/refused.
No store writes, activation, importer mutation, cutover, or best-tool decision. Name task-22cfca91c5134b24aaf3e5734444fb93 as the consumer edge.
Use TDD; every refusal test asserts exact stable reason code and refusing layer, generated matrices assert nonzero cases, and a mutation of the production mapper must redden a named assertion.
Keep each production source <=250 physical lines and split before 400; exact one-line LF .js bridges where root-reachable; stage/commit only explicit owned paths.
reopenReason: Governor promotion under the human's standing unstall directive: worker-filed prerequisite (shadow projection adapter), BACKLOG was create_task default, not triage.

comments.content: REMEASURED PREREQUISITES: current import events persist only canonicalPayload(record.payload); they irreversibly omit legacyId/sourcePath/provenance and cannot support this reader. Hard-depend first on task-a6775ac56d714da388e6b28343eb806e (versioned canonical import shadow facts) and task-1e44b9b9d50e4cbab57a09d0105fdade (daemon @moe/import manifest/lock edge). This task then owns only import-shadow-reader.ts, its LF bridge, its test, and daemon index export (4 files). Do not infer missing fields from eventId/type/counts/command result.

blockedReason: Fresh HEAD measurement found prerequisite task-a677's payload codec is present, but its production ImportEventDraft does not set domainSchemaVersion. A real SqliteEventStore stores every legacy.*.imported row under the generic moe-domain-schema/0 default while only the inner payload declares moe-import-event-facts/1. A strict daemon current-shadow reader would therefore have to ignore the event envelope's schema or bless an accidental generic default, contradicting the stale-dependency/fail-closed rails and the producer task's own DoD. Filed focused prerequisite task-9745cd06b8004f44af4128f69a251860 to require/stamp the exact outer schema and prove it with nonzero real-store replay. Reopen this task only after that task is DONE. The other dependencies are genuinely live: daemon package.json + pnpm-lock link @moe/import and a compiled inside-daemon bare-root probe typechecked exit 0; a677's canonical payload decoder is public. On reopen, this task needs five owned paths (reader.ts, LF bridge, reader.test.ts, daemon index.ts, index-surface.test.ts—the old four-file comment is stale because the daemon root export catalogue is exact). Its semantic scope is the durable v2 imported-state projection, never live work/graph authority: copied source uses projectLegacyImport, durable event bytes use an independent daemon mapper, and public compareShadowProjections compares them. Board counts and WorkClaimLedger remain invalid substitutes.
